title: House Price Estimator
description: Built a machine learning application to estimate California home prices using Python, Pandas, scikit-learn, Random Forest, and XGBoost. Cleaned housing data, explored important features, tuned models, and presented results through Tableau and Streamlit.

title: IDX Housing Data Analysis
description: Analyzed more than 70,000 California housing records to identify pricing patterns, examine missing values and outliers, and understand which property features were most related to home prices.

title: Cryptocurrency Risk Model Comparison
description: Explored approaches for evaluating cryptocurrency market risk by comparing traditional risk measures such as Value at Risk with time-series models such as GARCH.

title: Android Malware Analysis
description: Designed a Bayesian network approach to investigate how Android app permissions relate to malware. The proposed analysis uses permission data, maximum likelihood estimation, and probabilistic inference.

title: Reef Coral Health Classifier
description: Developed a coral health classification application using React, FastAPI, and scikit-learn, with Leaflet for map-based visualization of coral health information.

title: Interactive Course Planner
description: Built a course planning web application using React, Node.js, and drag-and-drop interactions to help students organize their classes and plan their schedules.

title: Beats by Dre Review Analysis
description: Analyzed more than 2,500 product reviews across multiple brands using Python, Pandas, Excel, and visualization tools to explore customer feedback and product trends.

title: Polymarket Insider Wallet Analysis
description: Investigated millions of prediction-market trades to identify potentially informed trading wallets. Used statistical hypothesis testing and bootstrapping to evaluate trading patterns and potential market advantages.

title: Drosophila Brain Image Analysis
description: Contributed to research involving 3D fruit fly brain image processing to investigate questions related to sleep and Alzheimer's disease. Organized and examined research data to support analysis.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: Created a personal portfolio website for showcasing data science projects, education, and experience. Used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript modules to organize pages and dynamically display project data.

title: Housing Data Visualization
description: Explored housing data through data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and visualization to communicate patterns and relationships in property prices and characteristics.

title: Retail Food Processing Analysis
description: Compared products from Walmart, Target, and Whole Foods to investigate whether higher prices consistently correspond to less-processed foods. Used data visualization to examine differences across retailers and product categories.
